title: Missables
description: Items, quests and characters that are lost for good after certain decisions — check here before key choices.

items.title: Paarthurnax
items.description: After "Dragonslayer", the Blades demand that you kill Paarthurnax. Killing him can't be undone, and refusing ends your cooperation with the Blades.
items.missable: Kill Paarthurnax and the dragon, his dialogue and his teachings are gone for good; the Greybeards turn their backs on you until you apologize. Spare him and Delphine and Esbern refuse to help (Blades recruiting, "Dragon Research" and the like) while he lives.

items.title: Civil War Faction
items.description: Once you join the Imperial Legion or the Stormcloaks, you can't switch sides.
items.missable: The other side's questline ("Joining the Stormcloaks" / "Joining the Legion" and everything after) is closed for good once you take the oath.

items.title: Season Unending
items.description: Peace talks between the Legion and the Stormcloaks where the holds are divided up.
items.missable: Finish the Civil War before this quest and the talks are skipped. Concessions made at the table (e.g. Markarth to the Stormcloaks) permanently change jarls and their quests.

items.title: Deposed Jarls' Quests
items.description: A conquered hold gets a new jarl, and the old one leaves with family and housecarl for Solitude (Imperials) or Windhelm (Stormcloaks). Their quests vanish. The list below is based on UESP.
items.missable: Siding with the Legion? Finish Aeri's delivery to Skald and the quests from Harrald, Korir and Brunwulf first. Siding with the Stormcloaks? Finish those from Igmund, Gorm, Idgrod the Younger, Dengeir and Angeline Morrard. Concessions at "Season Unending" change jarls the same way.
tips: You lose your Thane title when the jarl changes, but the new jarl usually offers it again right away.
Guards in a conquered hold forget your bounty.
Elisif in Solitude is the only jarl who is never replaced.

items.title: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!
items.description: In "With Friends Like These..." you can kill Astrid instead of the captives and turn the Brotherhood in to the guards.
items.missable: Choose "Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!" and you lose the entire Brotherhood questline, Shadowmere and the Sanctuary rewards for good.

items.title: Cicero
items.description: In "The Cure for Madness" you can kill Cicero or let him go.
items.missable: Kill Cicero and you lose him as a follower forever. If you spare him, you can later find him in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and recruit him.

items.title: Skeleton Key
items.description: Nocturnal's unbreakable lockpick, received in "Darkness Returns".
items.missable: Once you return the key to the Ebonmere, it's gone for good. Until the quest is done, you can keep using it.

items.title: Dawnguard Faction Choice
items.description: In "Bloodline", Lord Harkon offers to make you a Vampire Lord.
items.missable: The choice is final: the other side's quests (Dawnguard or the Volkihar Vampire Clan) are closed for good.

items.title: Destroying the Dawnguard
items.description: After the vampire storyline, you're sent to destroy the Dawnguard.
items.missable: Isran, Sorine Jurard, Gunmar and others die — the improved crossbows and bolts are gone from the shops forever.

items.title: Azura's Star / The Black Star
items.description: In "The Black Star" you can give the star to Aranea or to Nelacar.
items.missable: You can only get one of the two stars; the other is lost for good.

items.title: Ring of Hircine / Savior's Hide
items.description: In "Ill Met by Moonlight" you decide the fate of the werewolf Sinding.
items.missable: Kill Sinding to get the Savior's Hide; spare him to get the cleansed Ring of Hircine. The other artifact is lost.

items.title: Masque of Clavicus Vile / The Rueful Axe
items.description: At the end of "A Daedra's Best Friend", Clavicus Vile offers a trade.
items.missable: Kill Barbas to keep the Rueful Axe and lose the Masque; spare Barbas to get the Masque but lose the axe.

items.title: Mehrunes' Razor
items.description: In "Pieces of the Past", Mehrunes Dagon demands that you kill Silus Vesuius.
items.missable: Spare Silus and Mehrunes' Razor is lost for good.

items.title: Skull of Corruption
items.description: In "Waking Nightmare", Erandur performs a ritual to destroy the skull.
items.missable: Let Erandur finish the ritual and the Skull of Corruption is destroyed forever. Kill Erandur and you lose him as a follower.

items.title: Boethiah's Calling
items.description: To start "Boethiah's Calling", you must sacrifice a follower.
items.missable: The sacrificed follower dies for good. Use a hired mercenary, not your spouse or a unique companion.

items.title: Oghma Infinium
items.description: Hermaeus Mora's book raises the skills of the path you choose.
items.missable: You can only read it once — then the book disappears. The path you pick (warrior, thief, mage) is final.

items.title: Ring of Namira
items.description: In "The Taste of Death" you must hand Brother Verulus over to Namira's cannibals.
items.missable: Refuse and kill the cultists, and the Ring of Namira can't be obtained.

items.title: Aetherial Crown / Shield / Staff
items.location: The Aetherium Forge, Ruins of Bthalft
items.description: In the Dawnguard quest "Lost to the Ages", the forge lets you craft one item.
items.missable: You can choose only one: the Aetherial Crown, Shield or Staff. The other two are lost for good.

items.title: No One Escapes Cidhna Mine
items.en: Доспех Старых богов / кольцо Серебряной Крови
items.description: In Cidhna Mine you decide Madanach's fate.
items.missable: Escaping with Madanach gets you the Armor of the Old Gods; killing him gets you the Silver-Blood Family Ring. The other reward is lost.

items.title: In My Time of Need
items.description: In "In My Time of Need" you choose whom to help.
items.missable: Hand Saadia over and she's gone from Whiterun for good; kill Kematu and you lose the Alik'r. The choice is final.

items.title: Blood on the Ice
items.description: In "Blood on the Ice", suspicion falls on the court wizard Wuunferth.
items.missable: Wrongly accuse Wuunferth and he's jailed while the killings go on. Better to wait and ambush the real killer.

items.title: Frost
items.description: In "Promises to Keep" you can give Frost to Louis Letrush or keep him.
items.missable: Hand the horse over to Louis and you lose Frost — one of the toughest horses in the game.

items.title: Retaking Thirsk / The Chief of Thirsk Hall
items.description: You can retake Thirsk Mead Hall for Bujold's Nords or for the Rieklings.
items.missable: "Retaking Thirsk" and "The Chief of Thirsk Hall" are mutually exclusive: finish one and you lose the other.

items.title: Ebony Blade
items.description: Mephala's Ebony Blade grows stronger when you use it to kill friendly characters.
items.missable: To fully power the blade you must kill ten friends or followers with it — they die for good.

items.title: Followers and Spouses
items.description: Regular (non-essential) followers, housecarls and spouses can die in combat.
items.missable: A dead follower never comes back; their quests, trading or your spouse's shop income go with them. Keep important companions out of dangerous fights when you can.

items.title: Storn Crag-Strider
items.description: The Skaal shaman dies as part of the story in "The Gardener of Men".
items.missable: After this quest Storn is gone — talk to him beforehand.

items.title: Septimus Signus
items.description: The mad scholar who gives you "Discerning the Transmundane".
items.missable: At the end of the quest Hermaeus Mora kills Septimus — his outpost and dialogue are lost for good.
